descripcion.en: The past simple tells the main events of a story; the past continuous sets the background or an action interrupted by another. At B1 the goal is to combine both correctly: I was walking home when it started to rain.
descripcion.de: Das simple past erzählt die Hauptereignisse einer Geschichte; das past continuous beschreibt den Hintergrund oder eine Handlung, die von einer anderen unterbrochen wird. Auf B1-Niveau geht es darum, beide Zeiten korrekt zu kombinieren: I was walking home when it started to rain.
descripcion.es: El past simple narra los acontecimientos principales de una historia; el past continuous describe el trasfondo o una acción interrumpida por otra. En B1, el objetivo es combinar correctamente ambos tiempos: I was walking home when it started to rain.
descripcion.fr: Le past simple raconte les événements principaux d'un récit ; le past continuous décrit l'arrière-plan ou une action interrompue par une autre. Au niveau B1, l'objectif est de combiner correctement les deux : I was walking home when it started to rain.
descripcion.it: Il past simple racconta gli eventi principali di una storia; il past continuous descrive lo sfondo o un'azione interrotta da un'altra. Al livello B1, l'obiettivo è combinarli correttamente: I was walking home when it started to rain.
descripcion.pt: O past simple conta os principais acontecimentos de uma história; o past continuous descreve o contexto ou uma ação interrompida por outra. No nível B1, o objetivo é combinar os dois corretamente: I was walking home when it started to rain.

notas.en: When usually introduces the interrupting event (past simple); while introduces the background action (past continuous).
notas.de: When leitet normalerweise das unterbrechende Ereignis ein (past simple); while leitet die Hintergrundhandlung ein (past continuous).
notas.es: When suele introducir el acontecimiento que interrumpe (past simple); while introduce la acción de fondo (past continuous).
notas.fr: When introduit généralement l'événement qui interrompt (past simple) ; while introduit l'action d'arrière-plan (past continuous).
notas.it: When introduce di solito l'evento che interrompe (past simple); while introduce l'azione di sfondo (past continuous).
notas.pt: When geralmente introduz o evento que interrompe (past simple); while introduz a ação de fundo (past continuous).

notas.en: The past continuous is formed with was/were + -ing.
notas.de: Das past continuous wird mit was/were + -ing gebildet.
notas.es: El past continuous se forma con was/were + -ing.
notas.fr: Le past continuous se forme avec was/were + -ing.
notas.it: Il past continuous si forma con was/were + -ing.
notas.pt: O past continuous é formado com was/were + -ing.

notas.en: Not every past story needs the past continuous — use it only for background or interruption.
notas.de: Nicht jede Geschichte in der Vergangenheit braucht das past continuous – verwende es nur für Hintergrundhandlungen oder Unterbrechungen.
notas.es: No toda historia en pasado necesita el past continuous: úsalo solo para acciones de fondo o interrupciones.
notas.fr: Tous les récits au passé n'ont pas besoin du past continuous : utilise-le seulement pour l'arrière-plan ou une interruption.
notas.it: Non ogni racconto al passato richiede il past continuous: usalo solo per azioni di sfondo o interruzioni.
notas.pt: Nem toda história no passado precisa do past continuous — use-o apenas para ações de fundo ou interrupções.

contraste.es: Spanish uses the imperfecto for the background of a story (estaba cocinando) and the indefinido for the main event (sonó el teléfono), with a logic very close to English. The transfer is generally direct.
contraste.de: German has no continuous form and uses the Präteritum both for the background and for the main event (Als das Telefon klingelte, kochte ich). German speakers therefore under-use the past continuous and write When the phone rang, I cooked, which in English means that the cooking started after the call.
contraste.it: Italian has a very close equivalent: stavo cucinando (I was cooking) for the background and the passato prossimo for the main event. The transfer is usually direct; the one risk is the imperfetto for habits (andavo a scuola a piedi), which leads to I was going to school on foot instead of I used to go.
contraste.fr: The French imparfait covers the background (je cuisinais quand le téléphone a sonné), which maps well onto the past continuous. The imparfait is also used for habits (j'allais à l'école à pied), which leads to I was going to school on foot where English uses I used to go.
contraste.pt: Portuguese has a very close equivalent: estava a cozinhar (European) or estava cozinhando (Brazilian) for the background, and the simple past for the main event. The imperfeito for habits (ia a pé para a escola) leads to I was going on foot where English uses I used to go.

errores.en: Using the past simple for the background action instead of the past continuous.
errores.de: Das past simple für die Hintergrundhandlung verwenden statt des past continuous.
errores.es: Usar el past simple para la acción de fondo en lugar del past continuous.
errores.fr: Utiliser le past simple pour l'action d'arrière-plan au lieu du past continuous.
errores.it: Usare il past simple per l'azione di sfondo invece del past continuous.
errores.pt: Usar o past simple para a ação de fundo em vez do past continuous.

errores.pt: Usar when onde while seria mais natural, ou vice-versa.

errores.it: Dimenticare was/were prima della forma in -ing.
errores.pt: Esquecer was/were antes da forma em -ing.

autochequeo.en: Is the main event in the past simple?
autochequeo.de: Steht das Hauptereignis im Simple Past?
autochequeo.es: ¿El acontecimiento principal está en pasado simple?
autochequeo.it: L’evento principale è al past simple?
autochequeo.pt: O evento principal está no simple past?

autochequeo.en: Is the background action in the past continuous?
autochequeo.de: Steht die Hintergrundhandlung im past continuous?
autochequeo.es: ¿La acción de fondo está en past continuous?
autochequeo.fr: L'action d'arrière-plan est-elle au past continuous ?
autochequeo.it: L'azione di sfondo è al past continuous?
autochequeo.pt: A ação de fundo está no past continuous?

autochequeo.it: Was/were è usato correttamente prima di -ing?
autochequeo.pt: Was/were é usado corretamente antes de -ing?

autochequeo.en: Have I used both tenses at least once?
autochequeo.de: Habe ich beide Zeitformen mindestens einmal verwendet?
autochequeo.es: ¿He usado ambos tiempos al menos una vez?
autochequeo.fr: Ai-je utilisé les deux temps au moins une fois ?
autochequeo.it: Ho usato entrambi i tempi almeno una volta?
autochequeo.pt: Usei os dois tempos pelo menos uma vez?

autochequeo.en: Does the story sound natural, not translated?
autochequeo.de: Klingt die Geschichte natürlich und nicht übersetzt?
autochequeo.es: ¿La historia suena natural y no traducida?
autochequeo.fr: Le récit paraît-il naturel et non traduit ?
autochequeo.it: La storia suona naturale e non tradotta?
autochequeo.pt: A história soa natural, e não traduzida?

promptCorreccion.en: Focus only on past simple versus past continuous. Check whether the main event and the background action use the correct tense. Do not rewrite the text.
promptCorreccion.de: Konzentriere dich nur auf past simple und past continuous. Prüfe, ob das Hauptereignis und die Hintergrundhandlung in der richtigen Zeitform stehen. Schreibe den Text nicht um.
promptCorreccion.es: Concéntrate únicamente en past simple y past continuous. Comprueba si el acontecimiento principal y la acción de fondo usan el tiempo correcto. No reescribas el texto.
promptCorreccion.fr: Concentre-toi uniquement sur le past simple et le past continuous. Vérifie si l'événement principal et l'action d'arrière-plan utilisent le bon temps. Ne réécris pas le texte.
promptCorreccion.it: Concentrati solo sul past simple e sul past continuous. Controlla se l'evento principale e l'azione di sfondo usano il tempo corretto. Non riscrivere il testo.
promptCorreccion.pt: Concentre-se apenas no past simple e no past continuous. Verifique se o evento principal e a ação de fundo usam o tempo verbal correto. Não reescreva o texto.

es: Mapping the imperfect onto the past simple: *It rained when I left* from *llovía cuando salí* instead of *It was raining*.
de: Leaving out the progressive because German has none: *I read when he called* instead of *I was reading*.
it: Mapping the imperfect onto the past simple: *It rained when I left* from *pioveva quando sono uscito* instead of *It was raining*.
fr: Mapping the imperfect onto the past simple: *It rained when I left* from *il pleuvait quand je suis sorti* instead of *It was raining*.
pt: Mapping the imperfect onto the past simple: *It rained when I left* from *chovia quando saí* instead of *It was raining*.
